title: How is Charlemagne connected to Rin Itoshi?
description:
A Raphael fresco, 170 popes, a Vatican audience and Expo 2025 link the first Holy Roman Emperor to Blue Lock's Rin Itoshi.

Charlemagne → Pope Leo III → Pope Francis → Fumio Kishida → Masakazu Tokura → Yusei Yagi → Rin Itoshi

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Charlemagne → Pope Leo III: Raphael's workshop painted Pope Leo the Third crowning Charlemagne emperor in Rome in 800.
   Photo by Raphael, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Raphael_-_Coronation_of_Charlemagne_(cropped).jpg
2. Pope Leo III → Pope Francis (9 portraits, every holder): Leo the Third was the 96th pope, and the line runs 170 more popes to Pope Francis.
   Photo, Public domain / CC0 / CC BY-SA 3.0 / unknown: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pope_Leo_III.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Exultet_Rolls_of_Southern_Italy,_detail_of_Pope_Gregory_VII.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pope_Innocent_III_(Monastery_of_Subiaco).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pedro_Berruguete_-_Portrait_of_Pope_Sixtus_IV_della_Rovere_-_1916.815_-_Cleveland_Museum_of_ArtFXD.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Portrait_of_Pope_Paul_III_Farnese_(by_Titian)_-_National_Museum_of_Capodimonte.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pius_IX,_by_Adolphe_Braun,_1875.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ioannes_XXIII,_by_De_Agostini,_1958%E2%80%931963.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:ADAMELLO_-_PAPA_-_Giovanni_Paolo_II_-_panoramio_(cropped).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pope_Francis_Korea_Haemi_Castle_19_(4x5_cropped).jpg
3. Pope Francis → Fumio Kishida: In 2022, Pope Francis received Japan's prime minister Fumio Kishida at the Vatican.
   Photo by Prime Minister's Office of Japan (photo: Vatican Media), Fair use (commentary): https://japan.kantei.go.jp/101_kishida/actions/202205/_00004.html
4. Fumio Kishida → Masakazu Tokura: That July in Tokyo, Kishida counted down 1000 days to Expo 2025 with Expo chairman Masakazu Tokura.
   Photo by Japan Association for the 2025 World Exposition, via Keidanren Times, Fair use (commentary): https://www.keidanren.or.jp/journal/times/2022/0804_11.html
5. Masakazu Tokura → Yusei Yagi: In 2023, Tokura launched Expo ticket sales with the band Fantastics, including singer Yusei Yagi.
   Photo by Japan Association for the 2025 World Exposition, via Kyodo News PR Wire, Fair use (commentary): https://kyodonewsprwire.jp/release/202312053857
6. Yusei Yagi → Rin Itoshi: And in 2026, Yagi played Rin Itoshi in the live-action Blue Lock movie.
   Photo, Fair use (commentary): https://www.cinematoday.jp/news/N0156290 + https://bluelock-anime-en.com/

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#charlemagne #rinitoshi #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
